plan.empty.title: There is no household here yet
plan.empty.body: Setup comes in a later version. Until then, Holt has no plan to show.
plan.failed.title: The app couldn't read your plan
plan.failed.body: Nothing changed. You can try again.
plan.banner.none: Every {currency, select, NOK {krone} other {unit of money}} has a job
plan.banner.over: {amount} is over: move money from a job back to unassigned
plan.banner.notOpen: {month} isn't open yet. The amounts below are projections.
plan.banner.openEarlier: Open the months in order. {earlier} comes first.
plan.banner.openExplain: Opening {month} turns this plan into assignments that you can change.
plan.banner.closed: {month} is closed. Reopen it to change the plan.
plan.done.unassign: You moved {amount} from {from} back to unassigned.
plan.done.open: You opened {month}. The plan is now assignments that you can change.
plan.jobs.title: This month's jobs
plan.jobs.hint: Click an amount or press E to change it. Enter saves and Esc cancels. J and K move between jobs, and Enter opens one.
plan.jobs.hintProjection: These amounts are projections until you open the month. A ≈ marks an estimate by the app.
plan.panel.label: Job details
plan.status.buffer: {balance} of {target} ({months, plural, one {# month} other {# months}})
plan.problem.notAnAmount: That isn't an amount. Type a number such as 14500.
plan.problem.negative: You can't assign a negative amount.
plan.move.problem.chooseFrom: Choose the job to take money from.
plan.moveDialog.title: Move money
plan.moveDialog.hint: You choose where this month's money goes. Nothing changes until you press Move money.
plan.moveDialog.fromHelp: The list shows jobs with money assigned this month.
plan.moveDialog.pickHint: Choose the job that gets the money.
plan.where.title: Where the money sits
plan.where.intro: Accounts are real bank accounts. Buckets split one account into parts, each set aside for a job.
plan.where.remainder: Not set aside in a bucket
plan.where.exceeds: The buckets hold {amount} more than this account does.
plan.where.cause.moves: The likely cause is {count, plural, one {a move} other {# moves}} still to make at the bank into this account: {amounts}.
plan.where.cause.monthly: The likely cause is this month's move of {amount} into this account, which the plan asks you to make at the bank.
plan.where.cause.unknown: The app can't see why. Check the balance against your bank.
plan.where.children.title: Children's accounts
plan.where.children.intro: In each child's name. You pay into them from your jobs and enter their balances.
plan.where.enteredPlus: Balance entered by you on {date}, plus {amount} paid in since
plan.where.soon: These arrive with the New job flow. For now, you add an account or a bucket in New job, where you choose where the money sits.
